spell.arcane_addon.arcane_pulse.guide: Release a shockwave of raw arcane energy, damaging all enemies around you.
spell.arcane_addon.summon_greatsword.gui: Empty main hand: summon the Demon Slayer Sword. Holding it: summon the Demon Dweller Sword into your off hand. Holding both: swap them. Swapping to the Dweller makes the Slayer cut a wide horizontal slash with a slash aura; swapping to the Slayer makes the Dweller fire a dark slash projectile. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.empty_hand_required: Your main hand must be empty (or hold the Demon Slayer Sword) to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Black Grimoire.
spell.arcane_addon.piercing_dash.guide: Thrust the sword forward and dash through your enemies. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand the dash is faster and trails dark smoke, but hits lighter. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.sword_required: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword to use this spell.
Vanishes the moment it leaves your hand.
tooltip.arcane_addon.black_grimoire.1: Drains your mana while worn; spells cost none.
tooltip.arcane_addon.black_grimoire.2: Ten spell slots. Its power flows into your body.
spell.arcane_addon.zetten.guide: Concentrate anti magic into the sword and bring it down in one huge vertical slash. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes a fast X of two dark slashes. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.sky_splitter.guide: A long cutting beam of anti magic. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes twin dark beams. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.anti_magic.guide: Release anti magic from the sword in a wave that strips every magical effect from nearby enemies and cleanses your own ailments. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.ki_sense.guide: Open your sixth sense and perceive every living thing around you through walls. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.instinct_guard.guide: Your body moves on its own: for a moment nothing can hurt you. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_union.guide: Liebe merges with you for 50 seconds: great strength, speed, resilience, regeneration and mining speed, wrapped in black devil flame. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.offhand_empty_required: Your off hand must be empty to summon the Demon Dweller Sword.
tooltip.arcane_addon.demon_dweller_sword: Fast twin of the Demon Slayer Sword: lower damage, much faster swings.
Vanishes when it isn't in your hands. In the off hand: +2 attack damage, +0.4 attack speed.
spell.arcane_addon.dweller_slash.guide: Send a projected slash of Anti Magic flying out of the Demon Dweller Sword. It cuts everything in its path from a distance and strips their magical effects. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in either hand. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.borrowed_slash.guide: The Demon Dweller Sword borrows magic from the world around you: the projected slash takes on a random element - fire, ice, lightning or wind. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in either hand. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.dweller_required: Hold the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.any_sword_required: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword or the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
